import json,os,re,subprocess,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/work');src=work/'source';src.mkdir();(work/'home').mkdir();(work/'cargo').mkdir();(work/'cargo/registry').symlink_to('/cache/registry')
with tarfile.open('/input/source.tar') as a:a.extractall(src,filter='data')
records=[]
def run(name,cmd,env=None,diagnostic=None):
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=src,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
 data=p.stdout+p.stderr;(work/(name+'.log')).write_bytes(data)
 ok=(p.returncode==0 if diagnostic is None else p.returncode!=0 and re.search(diagnostic,data.decode(errors='replace'),re.S) is not None)
 records.append(dict(name=name,command=cmd,status='passed' if ok else 'failed',original_exit_status=p.returncode,diagnostic=diagnostic,environment={k:v for k,v in (env or os.environ).items() if k in ('RUSTUP_HOME','RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN','CARGO_HOME','MIRIFLAGS','CARGO_NET_OFFLINE','CARGO_TARGET_DIR')}))
 (work/'miri-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')

import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/work/source');out=Path('/work/fault-regressions');out.mkdir()
def run(name,cmd):
 with (out/(name+'.log')).open('wb') as log:
  subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=src,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print(name,'passed',flush=True)
run('glibc',['getconf','GNU_LIBC_VERSION'])
for name in ('cleanup_eintr','short_write'):
 run(name+'-build',['cc','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-shared','-fPIC',str(src/'tools/safety/native'/ (name+'.c')),'-ldl','-o',str(out/(name+'.so'))])
run('fault-paths',['python3','tools/safety/test_fault_paths.py','--normal','/work/source/target/debug/rless','--injected','/work/injected/debug/rless','--native-shim',str(out/'cleanup_eintr.so'),'--short-write-shim',str(out/'short_write.so'),'--repetitions','100'])
run('leak-reference',['python3','tools/safety/leaks.py','--capture-reference','--reference','/reference/less','--output',str(out/'leak-reference.json')])
sys.path.insert(0,str(src/'tools/safety'))
from leaks import cases
(out/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases(),indent=2))
run('leak-replay',['python3','tools/compat/run_v2.py','replay','--binary','/work/source/target/debug/rless','--cases',str(out/'cases.json'),'--expected',str(out/'leak-reference.json'),'--results',str(out/'leak-result.json')])
